newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB says rate move 'possible' Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: NAB says rate move 'possible' Wednesday.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Wednesday that it could possibly make an announcement later on its lending rates following the cut in official rates by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).
"It is possible," NAB spokesman Haydn Park said in reponse to a question on whether NAB would make an annoucement today on its interest rate.
Earlier, the RBA cut official cash rates by 0.5 percentage points to 5.0 percent, the fifth reduction in rates in a year.
NAB's prime business lending rate is currently 9.10 percent and its standard variable mortgage rate 7.20 percent.
